materials_exhausted.note: PMC/packet metadata report no supplementary files; XML/PDF/OA package figures/tables and linked DBAASP rows were sufficient for obtainable-only adjudication.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered the previously missing Table 3 sorbitol MIC matrix from local XML and rebuilt activity rows with units, fungal targets, controls, and locators. Worker-4 preserved DBAASP sequence identity as database-only because the paper names Temporin G but does not embed the exact sequence. Worker-6 source-reviewed the final activity, database, and mechanism layers and accepts the paper with explicit cautions, not clean acceptance.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP-linked rows are traceable to local packet database files and DOI/PMID. Exact sequence identity for DBAASP:DBAASPR_16137 is not in the primary article, so records remain database_only_no_primary_source with source-supported activity/citation context where available.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Tables 1, 2, and 3 were re-opened from paper.xml. Table footnotes provide µM units and replicate/statistical context. Table 3 is now represented as target/entity/value rows instead of a parser gap.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Membrane perturbation is accepted as direct assay evidence; ergosterol binding and cell-wall synthesis are negative/unsupported mechanisms; biofilm and morphogenesis effects remain phenotype-level activity claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: Open ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is resolvable because all local recoverable values needed by worker-2/4/6 were checked and no blocking material gap remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Local primary article supports the Temporin G name and activity tables but not the exact DBAASP sequence/modification identity; database sequence is retained from merged all_sequences.csv.
Packet/PMC metadata and supplementary index report zero supplementary assets; no external supplement was chased.
Figure/prose phenotype values are kept as approximate source-reported values where text gives approximations; exact graph-derived values were not fabricated.
